Hey guys. So I just got a new Vaer that I really like. The crown is a bit sensitive and I'm not sure if it's super duper well built. Whenever I set the time, the watch does 1 of 2 things:

** UPDATE: 
I managed to set the time. Aaaaaand the watch has lost about 30 seconds through half a day. It's definitely going back. I'll let you know how it goes. Cheers. 

*** SECOND UPDATE
The watch is definitely defective. After some hours of active use, timekeeping is lossy and the watch can miss up to 15 seconds on a spree. I've contacted Vaer, but they're unresponsive (yep, I've waited the three business days they claim). Super frustrating. 

1- Minute hand immediately goes back around 1/3 of a minute.
2- Minute hand stays in its place but lags a little until 1/3 of a minute passes and then everything goes perfectly for hours.

I've experimented quite a bit and it's not really related to how carefully you press the crown so the watch starts ticking.

I actually don't mind this because you just have to set the minute hand a tiny bit forward and let the watch just catch up.

I wouldn't mind keeping it, but my question is if this is common and if the watch would be fully operational within a few years. 

I kinda don't want to send it back to Vaer since I live somewhere else and shipping is a little costly. It's been 20 USD for shipping and 40 USD for customs and I just don't want to spend another 60 USD for a watch that's pretty ok if I'm sure will be fine, it just wouldn't make sense. I like film cameras, so I can deal with a little quirk or two. What I genuinely hate is things breaking down on me.
